OriginalScript: The West Gate citybound has moderate delays between 8 Mile Bridge and Todd Road / Cook Street, with roadworks citybound. The Tullamarine citybound is also under roadworks, with moderate delays between Melbourne Airport and Mickleham Road. The Western Freeway outbound has a five-kay stretch affected between Deer Park Bypass and Caroline Springs Boulevard. The Princes Freeway citybound has minor delays at High Street. The Monash Freeway and Eastern Freeway are both flowing well.
